name: Sagility
desc:
Work At Home - Credentialing Advocate | $16.00 to $20.00/hr + Performance Incentives | Data Entry Heavy, Some Provider Follow-Up, No Sales Expectations
Company: Sagility
Industry: Health Science

What Your Day Will Look Like:
Sagility handles behind-the-scenes healthcare work for health plans. In this role, you help make sure doctors and other healthcare providers are properly credentialed so they can keep seeing patients. You'll check providers' licenses, education, board certifications, and work history directly with the original sources. You'll keep their records accurate in the credentialing system, track when licenses, certifications, and malpractice insurance expire, and prepare complete files for review. When something is missing or doesn't match, you'll reach out to the provider to get the right paperwork. You'll also help with audits, answer questions about credentialing status, and do data entry for provider enrollment.

Soft Skills
- Attention to detail
- Organization and time management
- Professional follow-up
- Keeping information confidential
- Ownership and reliability
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: High school diploma or equivalent
Required Experience: At least 6 months at a single employer, preferably in healthcare or customer service
Preferred Experience: Administrative, healthcare operations, or healthcare data entry experience, credentialing software or provider databases (MP3, Echo, NOW, CAQH), and a basic understanding of healthcare compliance

Required Skills:
- Strong attention to detail and organization
- Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook)
- Strong written and verbal communication
- Managing several priorities and meeting deadlines
- Keeping sensitive information confidential
- Must be 18 or older
- Hardwired internet (at least 25 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload)
- A secure, private home workspace
- No absences during the first 90 days

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Enjoys checking documents for accuracy
- Likes organized, process-driven work with clear deadlines
- Is comfortable following up with providers until they get what they need
- Wants to grow in healthcare operations from home

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Gets bored with repetitive records and data entry
- Struggles with deadlines or small details
- Can't commit to perfect attendance for the first 90 days
- Doesn't have hardwired internet or a private workspace
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email
3. Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening went, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Credentialing and recredentialing
- Primary source verification
- Provider records management
- Healthcare compliance
- Expiration date tracking
- Data entry accuracy
- Audit support
- Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook
- Confidential information handling
- Deadline management

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- How do you make sure your work stays accurate when you're handling detailed records?
- A provider hasn't sent the document you need and the deadline is close. What do you do?
- How do you handle sensitive or confidential information?
- Tell us about a time you found an error in a document. What happened, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time you juggled several deadlines at once. How did you prioritize, and how did it turn out?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: $16.00 to $20.00/hr, plus performance-based incentives.
-Shift: Must have availability for any shift based on business needs. Can be discussed in final interview, offer stage. Flexible availability is required, including weekends if needed.
-Benefits: Paid virtual training, medical, dental, and vision after 90 days, Daily Pay option, PTO, 401(k) with employer contribution, life insurance, short and long-term disability, FSA, EAP, tuition reimbursement, and wellness programs.
-Equipment Provided: Not stated in the posting. Hardwired internet is required. Ask about equipment in the interview.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case
-Drug Test: Certain positions
-Notes: This is a strong entry point into healthcare operations, and Sagility says 90% of its leaders started in entry-level roles. The posting requires a secure, private workspace, and WRO's coworking spaces are HIPAA compliant private offices with closed doors. Participants need perfect attendance for the first 90 days. Training length and camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Credentialing Advocate → Senior Credentialing Specialist → Credentialing Team Lead → Provider Enrollment or Compliance Analyst → Operations Manager. This role builds credentialing, healthcare compliance, and records management skills.
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
